verdict.rationale: The CLI ships `skills init [name]` to scaffold a SKILL.md template. The agentskills.io spec defines the required format (YAML frontmatter plus Markdown, optional fields like allowed-tools, bundled scripts and resources) and offers a `skills-ref validate` step. A `skill-creator` meta-skill is installable from vercel-labs/agent-skills, and finished skills can be distributed via a git repo or a direct SKILL.md/archive URL. Missing for 10: any description of what the skill-creator meta-skill actually does, an explicit documented packaging/publishing workflow (it is only implied by add-from-repo/URL), and independent or hands-on corroboration of an agent authoring a skill end to end.
